source.notes: Typeset school paper with no usable text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. Printed header: Final Examination - 2017-2018, HISTORY & CIVICS, Std. : VI, Time : 2 hrs., F. M. : 80; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session. The paper has no Geography section, so only a History & Civics pack was built. Numbering restarts in each group, so the group numeral (I-IX) is stored as the question number and the item number as the part. Where only a group total is printed it is divided evenly (I: by blanks). Group IX (Jharkhand, highest judicial body, gallantry award) is general knowledge and is left unmapped, as are the items on public/private property and protecting monuments. The paper's own spellings (e.g. 'Maryas', 'Parini', 'Fa Wien', 'Bhuddhism') are kept. The icseboard.org watermark is ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
